args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

PURCHASE ORDER & PROCUREMENT:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 ✓ BEST for establish POs and contractual terms
Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1 ✓ for cost impact analysis using historical pricing & vendor metrics
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1

PRODUCT LAUNCH VENDOR COMPLIANCE PROCESS:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 ✓ Part of ProductLaunchVendorCompliance process (step 1)
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 ✓ Part of ProductLaunchVendorCompliance (PO/contract finalization)

MANUFACTURING EXECUTION & CAPACITY PLANNING:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1 - handles "schedule-machines", "sequence-work-orders", manufacturing execution orchestration

CAMPAIGN PERFORMANCE & MARKETING ANALYTICS:
Agent: sap.crm:agent:CampaignAudienceOptimizationCoordinator:v1 ✓ BEST for assessing campaign performance impact - monitors campaign performance across customer segments, dynamically adjusts strategies based on metrics
Agent: emarsys.cx:agent:SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer:v1 ✓ Alternative - analyzes customer segment performance and campaign indicators for real-time campaign optimization
Agent: emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1 - coordinates customer engagement campaigns when product changes occur

WORKFORCE SAFETY & COMPENSATION:
Agent: sap.sf:agent:OccupationalSafetyComplianceMonitor:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1

ENGINEERING & CHANGE MANAGEMENT:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1
